title: Light Rays Background
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c "npm ci && npm run build"

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists

asset_issues.resolution: Used the complete supplied React component and layout; no external media or fonts required.

notes: Only this design was implemented. No agents, additional sessions, deployment, push, or external messages.
Supplied top-center shader coordinate mismatch corrected; fragment coordinates and mouse position now share top-down coordinates.
Mobile frame and Reply insets adapted to 24px; desktop preserves supplied 96px frame and 48px Reply offsets.
Browser checks used Chromium software WebGL; GPU performance and other engines were not measured.
Reply calls window.history.back() exactly as requested; prior browser history is required.
Ready means available for review, not deployed.
